messages:
maria: Hey — heads up, hitting a weird edge with the SDK's credential discovery during local key rotation.
alex: summary? what behavior are you seeing?
maria: SDK silently continues to use an old file-backed key after we rotate the env var. localagent rotates keys to ~/.redwood/creds.json and sets REDWOOD_API_KEY, but the SDK keeps calling with the old token until restart.
shu: is the SDK watching the env var or reading file every call? last I checked it reads env first then falls back to file at init.
maria: yeah looks like init-only. that's the problem for local dev where the rotate script swaps creds while process runs.
sam: ugh. that's a pretty common DX pain. quick question: do you want hot-reload behavior or an explicit refresh API?
maria: ideally both? hot-reload with a sane debounce, but a manual refresh would unblock us now.
alex: agree on debounce. otherwise you get thrash if a rotation tool writes multiple times. suggest: check env var on every request, but cache token for 2s.
shu: note: we also support KMS/HSM plugins that return short-lived tokens — polling every request may add overhead. propose: default behaviour = check env on every request, if env unchanged use cached; if file used, watch inode mtime with 5s jitter.
dev-tools-bot: deploy-preview: branch hot-reload-cred -> staging (tests pass) :white_check_mark:
maria: nice — can we get a dev-preview binary? I can validate with local agent.
alex: attaching quick patch snippet that adds CredProvider.refresh(force=false) and env watcher:```js
// pseudocode
class CredProvider {
  constructor() { this._lastEnv = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY; this._cached = this._lastEnv; }
  getToken() { const cur = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY; if (cur && cur !== this._lastEnv) { this._lastEnv = cur; this._cached = cur; }
    return this._cached;
  }
  async refresh() { this._cached = await readFileCred() || process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY; }
}
```
shu: looks fine. two asks: (1) document semantics in SDK readme, (2) add opt-out env REDWOOD_CRED_HOTRELOAD=false for deterministic infra.
sam: also call out org/project scoping: if REDWOOD_PROJECT_ID changes during runtime we should error until restart — routing decisions are heavy.
maria: good point — we shouldn't change project context live. will add a validation that project/org env changes require restart.
alex: one more quirk: rotation tooling on mac/os sometimes replaces file via atomic rename which keeps old inode for a short time on some FS. inode mtime watch may miss it. recommend watching file checksum+mtime combined.
shu: ack. implement mtime + file-hash quick check.
maria: thanks! I'll try the staging build and report back. for tracking: created GH issue #1423 to add refresh API and hot-reload opts. tagging @eng-sdk for follow-up. :pray:
sam: thanks for filing. minor UX note — add a short log line at info level when token source switches (env->file or file->env) so devs can debug without stepping through code.
alex: +1 to logs. also update sample app to include rotation demo script under examples/local-rotate.sh.
maria: great. will validate and close the loop.
